cleansingStrength.rationale: `moderate` by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2, prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3 and Coco-Glucoside@5, no reinforcing strong anionic. Salicylic Acid@7 is an acid (no route).

conditioningLevel.rationale: `moderate`: interacting light routes — cationic Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@10, cationic conditioner Quaternium-80@12, weak refatters (Glyceryl Oleate@8, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@11, Lecithin@15, Ascorbyl Palmitate@16), humectants Glycerin@4, Panthenol@6, Sodium Hyaluronate@9. C2 not met: no early silicone (Quaternium-80 is recorded as a cationic conditioner, 6.4), no payload lipid, no pearlizing/fatty route. Neighbor `high`: two cationic routes plus a dense humectant/refatter cluster come close to 'multiple complementary systems'.

wLineRecord.testedCandidate: Panthenol@6: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) entries 7-20 contain no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax (Glyceryl Oleate and the glyceride citrate are refatters in no C3 cleansing class) -> plausible

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Three interacting deposition families (cationic_polymer, cationic_conditioner, weak_refatter) plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not `low`: two distinct cationic families plus a refatter cluster converge, so calling it lightweight would understate residue (W2 — no single family is trace, and the reset is only ordinary). Not `high`: no silicone system, no payload lipid, no W-RICH; the cationic routes are single light members.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: doses of guar and Quaternium-80 unknown; all routes light, so `low` is realistic.
weightPotential.rationale: `moderate`: interacting light cationic + refatter routes under an ordinary reset (6.6, W2). Neighbor `low` (more realistic than `high`: no silicone or lipid).
